B Glenmore Landing: linework vs. aerial imagery

Same 1 km frame and scale as the linework (EPSG:3776). Imagery: Esri World Imagery (Esri, Maxar, Earthstar Geographics), warped to the local frame; date varies. White and red = what the base has now. Bright colours (NEW) = City Impervious Surface 2021 outlines that would fill the gaps. Driveways off by default.
